svg.title: Chevron right
svg.desc: `CHEV` on each book row of the chapter picker (2.4); `TUCK` button that tucks a card aside in Connections, Genealogy and Timeline (2); “Next plate” in the atlas (2.2); the margin tab “Notes in the margin” at the left edge of the reader (stroke 3). (Drawn at stroke-width 2, 2.2, 2.4, 3 in different places.)
